rules.sentence: The most common cause of intestinal obstruction in patients aged under 5 years was intussusception.
After the age of 5 through the age of 35years the most common cause of intestinal obstruction was adhesive intestinal obstruction.
The other common causes of intestinal obstruction in these age groups were small bowel volvulus, hernia and sigmoid volvulus.

Starting from the age of 20(the minimum age recorded for sigmoid volvulus) the incidence of sigmoid volvulus rises progressively and it was the most common cause of intestinal obstruction in patients with an age greater than 35 years (Table 3).
